name: keel-trade
description: Build and backtest Hyperliquid perpetual-futures strategies with your AI assistant: typed strategy composition and deterministic backtests on real Hyperliquid market history.
long_description:
Keel is an MCP server for building and testing systematic strategies for Hyperliquid perpetual futures. Your assistant composes strategies from typed, versioned components, validates them, and runs deterministic backtests on real Hyperliquid history, with fees, slippage, and perp carry costs modeled. You can also browse the verified strategy library, compare runs, keep notes on strategies, and share results.

Sign in once with `keel_auth_login`: it opens your browser, completes the OAuth sign-in, and keeps you signed in for 30 days.

By default, this bundle cannot place orders or move funds: running a strategy with real capital happens in the Keel web app. The local tools that act on a live account stay off unless you enable them yourself and arm them on your machine.

Keel measures the strategies you design. It is not investment advice, and backtest results do not predict future returns.

First launch takes about 10–30 seconds while the bundle installs its runtime dependencies to ~/.keel/mcpb-lib/py3.X/; later launches reuse them and start instantly. Requires system Python 3.11+ with pip, and internet access on first run.
